description: Defines complex number types and conversions for the ocudu library, including custom complex types based on 16-bit floating point, and formatters for printing complex numbers.

classes.name: cbf16_t
classes.description: A storage-only complex number type based on 16-bit floating point, with equality operators.

classes.name: formatter_template
classes.description: A template formatter for complex types, providing custom string formatting.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::cf_t>
classes.description: Formatter specialization for float complex type.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::ci8_t>
classes.description: Formatter specialization for int8 complex type.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::ci16_t>
classes.description: Formatter specialization for int16 complex type.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::cbf16_t>
classes.description: Formatter for the custom 16-bit floating point complex type, converting to cf_t for formatting.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a std::complex from one type to another.

methods.name: to_ci8
methods.description: Converts a cf_t complex number to an int8 complex number.

methods.name: to_ci16
methods.description: Converts a cf_t complex number to an int16 complex number.

methods.name: to_cf
methods.description: Converts various complex types to cf_t or from cbf16_t to cf_t.
